config.note: Bare 'nahi/no' or an explicit denial ('wrong number', 'main nahi hoon') at THIS step means wrong person. Recording objection or 'don't want to talk' -> declined_recording (opted_out, no persuasion). DEFAULT TO 'confirmed' for any affirmative or go-ahead reply, even if it doesn't repeat the customer's name (e.g. 'bolo', 'boliye', 'bol raha hoon', 'haan bolo', 'speaking') -- the customer is not required to say their own name back. Only a clear denial routes to wrong_number. Never fall back to an undefined clarifying question like 'aap kya chahte hain' -- that is not part of this flow.

entity.matchPrecedence: 'confirmed' is the DEFAULT outcome for this question. Any reply that is not a clear denial (wrong_number synonyms) and not clearly bad_time or declined_recording wins as 'confirmed' -- including short filler words, mumbled/unclear replies, and spellings not listed verbatim (e.g. 'haan bolo', 'hmm bolo', 'bol raha hoon boliye', 'aage bolo').
entity.unmatchedFallbackNote: If the reply does not clearly match wrong_number / bad_time / declined_recording, DEFAULT TO 'confirmed' and proceed straight to Purpose. This applies even to single filler words, mumbled or unclear audio, or spellings/variants not in the synonym list -- treat those as confirmed too, never as unmatched/unclear. Do NOT ask a clarifying question at this step -- none is defined here, and on an outbound call any reply that is not an unmistakable denial means 'yes, go ahead'. Only route away from confirmed when the reply is a clear denial or matches one of the other three categories.

config.instructions: ARRIVAL RULE: if the immediately preceding node was n_experience_ack, its message already asked this exact question as its own last sentence - do NOT speak this question again, just silently wait for and capture the customer's number. A rating of 3, 4, or 5 always skips straight to n_reuse (edge e14) - full stop, no reason question, ever. service_rating <= 2 is the ONLY case where n_rating_low_reason (edge e13) may run. requires.hardBlock: DO NOT REPEAT THIS FAILURE: never speak questionIfIssueKnown ('...kya wahi is rating ki wajah hai?') together with, before, or blended into the n_rating scale question in the same turn, and never speak it at all while service_rating is empty - this includes pulling it in right after n_experience_ack purely because issue_topic is already known. issue_topic being known is NOT a trigger for this node; only a captured numeric service_rating <= 2 is the trigger.

config.instructions: CRITICAL GATE, CHECK FIRST, EVERY TIME: this node may run ONLY if service_rating is a captured number AND that number is 0, 1, or 2. If service_rating is 3, 4, or 5 - even if an issue was mentioned earlier - this node NEVER runs and this question is NEVER spoken; go straight to n_reuse instead. CASE A (issue_already_reported == true): never ask the open 'कोई particular वजह है?'. Ask ONLY the confirmation in questionIfIssueKnown (same earlier reason, or something else). (3) says 'kuch aur hai' / 'nahi' / 'aur bhi hai' WITHOUT detail => ask ONCE questionIfOtherReason, store the answer, go to n_rating_low_ack. CASE B (no issue reported earlier): ask the open question once; set issue_already_reported=true, experience_issue_detail, issue_topic from the answer. One question at a time; after the reply go to n_rating_low_ack then the reuse question in the same turn.
config.entryCondition: ONLY when service_rating has ALREADY been captured in this call (customer actually gave a number) AND service_rating <= 2. NEVER reachable straight from n_experience / n_experience_issue / n_experience_ack. If service_rating is empty this node must not run.
